test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

G _ _ D O _ K N _ O G K _ D _ G K _ _ O

options.text: K N D G N O N D
K N G N D O N D
K N G D N O G D
K N G D N O N D

solution:
Given :- G _ _ D O _ K N _ O G K _ D _ G K _ _ O

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) K N D G N O N D → G **K N** D O - **D** K N **G** O - G K **N** D **O** - G K **N D** O

2) K N G N D O N D → G **K N** D O - **G** K N **N** O - G K **D** D **O** - G K **N D** O

3) K N G D N O G D → G **K N** D O - **G** K N **D** O - G K **N** D **O** - G K **G D** O

4) K N G D N O N D → G **K N **D O - **G** K N **D** O - G K **N** D **O** - G K **N D** O

 
• Here, **"GKNDO"** is repeated.
 
• Option (4) is gives the pattern of :- G K N D O - G K N D O - G K N D O - G K N D O

Hence, the correct answer is **"K N G D N O N D".**
